root_cause.text: The MPC52xx SPI driver does not release requested interrupts and cancel scheduled work when controller registration fails, leaving dangling pointers that can be used after the device memory is freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `free_irq(ms->irq0, ms); free_irq(ms->irq1, ms); cancel_work_sync(&ms->work);` in the `err_register:` error path, which was missing previously, to prevent use-after-free and resource leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing IRQ and work cleanup in the probe error path of mpc52xx_spi driver.
intent_record.what: Added free_irq for irq0 and irq1, and cancel_work_sync for work, in the error path after spi_register_host failure (err_register label) before err_gpio.
intent_record.how: When probe fails after IRQs have been requested and work scheduled, these resources are now freed/canceled, preventing resource leaks and potential use-after-free.
